national_news.title: Indian Railways Commissions KAVACH 4.0 on South Central Railway
bullets: Indian Railways successfully commissioned KAVACH Version 4.0 for the first time over a 108 Route Kilometre section on the Malkajgiri-Kamareddi section of Hyderabad Division.
KAVACH is an indigenously developed Automatic Train Protection (ATP) system designed to assist Loco Pilots and prevent Signal Passing at Danger (SPAD).
Version 4.0 upgrades from Version 3.2, offering advanced technology, higher reliability, and safer operations during inclement weather conditions.

national_news.title: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY Completes Eight Years with Over 60 Crore Beneficiaries
bullets: Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB-PMJAY), launched in September 2018 from Ranchi, Jharkhand, completed eight years as the world's largest government-funded health assurance scheme.
Over 60 crore beneficiaries have been provided access to an annual health cover of 5 lakh rupees, with more than 48.54 crore Ayushman cards created.
The government has empanelled 38,000 hospitals and recently extended benefits to senior citizens aged 70 and above, along with ASHAs and Anganwadi workers.

national_news.title: Indian Athletes Shine at Asian Games with Historic Medals in Skeet and Weightlifting
bullets: The Indian women’s skeet team (Parinaaz Dhaliwal, Raiza Dhillon, and Maheshwari Chauhan) won a historic bronze medal at the Asian Games.
The men’s skeet team (Anantjeet Singh Naruka, Bhavtegh Singh Gill, and Mairaj Ahmad Khan) also secured a bronze medal.
Mirabai Chanu clinched a silver medal in the women’s 49 kg weightlifting event, marking her first Asian Games medal and India's first in the category in 28 years.

national_news.title: Asian Games Day 4: India's Medal Tally Reaches Eight with Multiple Finishes
bullets: India's medal tally reached eight on Day 4 of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games following bronze medals in the women's and men's skeet shooting team events.
Jay Meena secured India's first-ever medal in soft tennis by advancing to the semifinals in the men's singles event.
Several athletes advanced to finals and medal rounds across disciplines including rowing, canoeing, shooting, and swimming.

national_news.title: PM SVANidhi Scheme Empowers Street Vendors in Telangana
bullets: The PM SVANidhi scheme, launched by the Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs, has been extended through March 2030 to provide collateral-free credit in structured tranches of ₹10,000, ₹20,000, and ₹50,000.
In Telangana, the scheme has disbursed over ₹1,240 crore, benefiting approximately 4.47 lakh street vendors, with women accounting for nearly 65% of local recipients.
The initiative integrates vendors into the formal banking system through UPI-linked RuPay SVANidhi credit cards, contributing to an average increase of over 20% in vendor household incomes.

national_news.title: Civil Aviation Ministry Launches Challenge Mode for Aerodrome Development under UDAN Scheme
bullets: Union Minister of Civil Aviation Ram Mohan Naidu signed MoUs with 21 States and UTs for the next phase of the UDAN (Ude Desh ka Aam Nagrik) scheme.
Since inception, UDAN has operationalized 687 routes and 95 aerodromes, carrying around 1.71 crore passengers.
The modified UDAN scheme rests on four pillars: passenger affordability, operational sustainability, a transparent Challenge Mode framework, and the promotion of indigenous manufacturing.

national_news.title: Ministry of Ayush Organizes 11th Ayurveda Day in Nagpur
bullets: The Ministry of Ayush hosted the 11th Ayurveda Day in Nagpur around the theme 'Ayurveda for a Healthier Tomorrow'.
Scientific sessions focused on integrating therapies to decrease the Non-Communicable Diseases (NCD) burden by 2027.
Key initiatives launched include the 'Ayush Vision 2030' report, a report on Ayush inventions, and the CCRAS-AGNI Assessment Scale Web Portal.

national_news.title: 72nd National Film Awards Announced: Anant Nag Honoured with Dadasaheb Phalke Award
bullets: President Droupadi Murmu presented the 72nd National Film Awards for 2024 at the Statue of Unity in Ekta Nagar, Gujarat, recognizing 92 awardees.
Veteran actor Anant Nag was honoured with the prestigious Dadasaheb Phalke Award for 2024 for his over five-decade contribution to Indian cinema.
The political thriller 'Article 370' won the Swarna Kamal for Best Feature Film, while Mammootty and Kartik Aaryan jointly won Best Actor in a Leading Role.

national_news.title: India Condemns Pakistani Airstrikes on Afghanistan and Rejects False Indus Water Treaty Claims
bullets: External Affairs Ministry strongly condemned Pakistan's airstrikes in Afghanistan's Kunar and Paktika provinces, terming it aggression against a sovereign neighbor.
MEA spokesperson Randhir Jaiswal emphasized that Pakistan must take credible action against cross-border terrorism before making claims.
India rejected the ruling on the Indus Water Treaty by an illegally constituted Court of Arbitration, calling it an attempt to distort reality.

national_news.title: Home Minister Amit Shah Inaugurates 3rd ANTF Conference, Sets 2029 Roadmap for Drug-Free India
bullets: Union Home Minister Amit Shah inaugurated the 3rd National Conference of Anti-Narcotics Task Force (ANTF) Heads in New Delhi, setting a roadmap to uproot the drug trade by 2029.
The government aims to shift strategy from a seizure-centric approach to dismantling entire drug networks, targeting entry points, interstate distribution, and local cells.
Nashamukt Mitras will visit 10 lakh educational institutions to create youth awareness, and the Narcotics Control Bureau (NCB) launched a new website and vision document (2026-29).

national_news.title: Centre Inks MoUs with 21 States and UTs for Next Phase of UDAN Scheme
bullets: 21 states and Union Territories signed MoUs with the Civil Aviation Ministry in New Delhi for the next phase of the UDAN (Ude Desh ka Aam Naagrik) scheme.
The government aims to construct 100 new airports and 200 modern heliports or helipads over the next 10 years, targeting 4 crore passengers.
The Challenge Mode Portal for Aerodrome Development was launched to fast-track airport projects, reducing construction timelines to an 18-month target.

national_news.title: 9th India International Water Week 2026 Inaugurated
bullets: Vice President C P Radhakrishnan inaugurated the 9th India International Water Week 2026 in New Delhi.
The theme for this year's event is 'Climate Resilient Water Management'.
The event focuses on integrated water management strategies, including river-basin management, groundwater recharge, and rainwater harvesting to combat climate change-induced rainfall uncertainty.

national_news.title: 3rd National Conference of Anti-Narcotics Task Force Heads
bullets: Union Home Minister Amit Shah inaugurated the 3rd National Conference of ANTF Heads in New Delhi.
The conference focuses on the 'Vision Document on Narcotics Control (2026-29)' and the theme 'United Resolve, Shared Responsibility'.
The Narcotics Control Bureau (NCB) organized the event to strengthen supply, demand, and harm reduction strategies across all 36 States and UTs.

national_news.title: Sikkim's Progress in Organic and Natural Farming
bullets: Sikkim was declared India's first organic state in 2016.
The state produces approximately 90% of India's large cardamom and has received GI certification for buckwheat.
The Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY) and collaborations with ICAR Sikkim are cited as key drivers for the state's natural farming growth.

national_news.title: PIB Organizes Media Workshop 'Vartalap' on Cyber Suraksha Bharat in Dimapur
bullets: The Press Information Bureau (PIB) organized a media workshop 'Vartalap' on Cyber Suraksha Bharat at Dimapur, Nagaland.
Discussions covered legal distinctions between civil and criminal defamation under Section 356 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) 2023.
Experts highlighted that 80-85% of all reported cybercrimes in Nagaland are concentrated in Dimapur and Kohima, driven by social engineering techniques.

national_news.title: Ministry of Defence Inks Rs 586 Crore Contract for Auxiliary Power Units for T-72 and T-90 Tanks
bullets: The Ministry of Defence signed a Rs 586 crore contract with Accurate Industrial Controls Private Limited for Auxiliary Power Units (APUs).
APUs serve as an alternate power source for fire control, firing circuits, and gun stabilization systems on T-72 and T-90 tanks.
The procurement falls under the Make-II category, boosting indigenous defense manufacturing and Aatmanirbharta.

national_news.title: Swachh Bharat Mission-Urban: Transforming Legacy Dumpsites into Eco-Parks
bullets: Swachh Bharat Mission-Urban (SBM-U), launched in October 2014, and SBM-U 2.0 (October 2021) drive the scientific remediation of legacy waste sites across India.
A total of 3.66 crore metric tonnes of legacy waste was remediated between January and December 2025 across 459 Urban Local Bodies in 29 States.
In Gorakhpur, Uttar Pradesh, a 40-acre legacy dumpsite was successfully remediated via biomining and converted into the 'Kachre Se Kanchan Rapti Eco Park'.

national_news.title: Media Delegation Reviews Infrastructure and NHAI Projects in Jammu and Kashmir
bullets: A 10-member media delegation from Bhopal interacted with PIB Jammu officials regarding development in J&K following the abrogation of Article 370.
NHAI officials reported that 22 projects covering 382 km have been completed at Rs 14,819 crore, with 16 projects underway.
The Zojila Tunnel is slated to become operational by December 2027, significantly improving regional connectivity.

national_news.title: DRI Conducts Nationwide Crackdown on Drug Trafficking
bullets: The Directorate of Revenue Intelligence (DRI) seized over 845 kg of narcotic drugs and psychotropic substances, including cannabis, charas, cocaine, and amphetamine.
A total of 15 individuals were arrested under the provisions of the Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances (NDPS) Act, 1985.
Key operations included a major seizure of 752.3 kg of ganja near Bodh Gaya, Bihar, and significant interceptions at Mumbai, Bengaluru, Delhi, and Gorakhpur airports and railway stations.
The operations were coordinated by the Ministry of Finance to disrupt organized drug-trafficking networks and identify innovative concealment methods.

bihar_news.title: PhonePe Receives In-Principle Approval for Two Payment Licences from UAE Central Bank
bullets: Indian fintech company PhonePe received in-principle approval from the Central Bank of the UAE on 22 September 2026 for two payment licences.
The approvals cover Retail Payment Services and Card Schemes (RPSCS) and Stored Value Facilities (SVF), marking PhonePe's first international expansion.
The company plans to collaborate with regional banks and support UAE domestic payment rails like Aani and Jaywan.

bihar_news.title: Severe Floods Affect Over 50 Lakh People Across 15 Districts in Bihar
bullets: Over 50.49 lakh people across 576 gram panchayats in 15 districts of Bihar have been affected by severe flooding as of September 2026.
Rivers including the Kosi and Ganga are flowing above the danger mark at multiple locations such as Baltara, Kursela, and Kahalgaon.
Rescue and relief operations involve 27 State Disaster Response Force (SDRF) teams, 8 National Disaster Response Force (NDRF) teams, and 391 deployed boats.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Government Outlines Major Push for Energy and Education Sectors
bullets: Bihar Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary revealed that 1.7 crore families in the state have not received an electricity bill for an entire year, with only 22 lakh families currently paying for power.
The state government allocates approximately Rs 6,000 crore annually for agricultural feeders in rural areas to boost the rural power infrastructure.
The government aims to integrate more households and agricultural supply with solar power to reduce dependency on traditional subsidies.

bihar_news.title: Long Leaves Taken by Chiefs of Three Key Bihar Police and Public Service Organizations
bullets: Heads of three major organizations in Bihar—DGP Vinay Kumar, BPSC Chairperson Parmar Ravi Manubhai, and BPSSC Chairperson K S Dwivedi—proceeded on simultaneous long leaves ranging from 21 days to a month.
Preeta Verma assumed additional charge as acting DGP, and Harjot Kaur Bamhra took charge as BPSC Chairman as interim arrangements.
No interim arrangement was immediately announced for the Bihar Police Subordinate Services Commission (BPSSC), raising administrative eyebrows.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Saras Mela 2026 Held in Patna
bullets: Organized by JEEViKA under the Rural Development Department, Government of Bihar, at Gyan Bhawan, Patna from September 20-29, 2026.
Features participation from rural women entrepreneurs and Self-Help Groups (SHGs) from Bihar and 14 other states.
Launched a new logo for 'Biharika', a collective brand for products made by Bihar's rural women entrepreneurs.
Aims to provide market linkages for products like Madhubani paintings, khadi, silk, and traditional food items.

bihar_news.title: Bihar CM Reviews 'Bihar Gati' Infrastructure Projects
bullets: CM directed the launch of the Integrated Manufacturing Cluster (IMC) in Gaya by mid-October under the Amritsar-Kolkata Industrial Corridor (AKIC).
The Gaya IMC project is expected to attract industrial investments worth approximately Rs 20,000 crore.
Directed the release of pending honorariums for Anganwadi and frontline workers before the Durga Puja festival.
Reviewed road connectivity projects including the four-laning of the Sultanganj-Tarapur-Sangrampur-Belhar-Katoria-Chandan-Dardmara route.

bihar_news.title: Proposed Bihar Green Hydrogen Policy 2026
bullets: Proposed policy aims to attract Rs 16,000 crore in investment and create 12,000 jobs in the state.
Aligned with the National Green Hydrogen Mission-2030, which targets 5 million metric tonnes of annual production capacity in India.
Government plans to explore feasibility of hydrogen plants in coordination with Barauni Refinery and Hindustan Urvarak Rasayan Limited (HURL).
Focuses on developing production, consumption, and supporting infrastructure for green energy in Bihar.

bihar_news.title: Patna High Court Directs Bihar Government on Prisoner Remission Transparency and Safeguards
bullets: The Patna High Court issued directives to ensure transparency in remission records, pre-forfeiture hearings, and grievance mechanisms under the Bihar Prison Manual, 2012.
Under the rules, eligible convicted prisoners can earn ordinary remission up to seven days a month and 84 days a year based on good conduct and work.
The Court mandated supplying prisoners with a duplicate copy of their History Ticket and recommended fixed timelines for premature-release proceedings.
